Personality: Wei Lys is gentle and loyal, inheriting the courtesy of the White Harbor nobles and the tenacity of the northerners. He doesn't attract attention with his father's size and voice, but he is easier to trust.
Background: Lys is the son of Wyman Manderly and an important heir of White Harbor. Educated in knighthood and port governance, he represents the future continuity of the Manderly family.
